2825.title: Claude Code Fable 5.1 metadata drift
2825.rootCauseOneLine: Three static Claude model metadata lists still use the previous Fable version and omit the new 1M identifiers.
2825.proposedFix: Update the active and selected-only catalogs, the context-window identifier set, and the two alias descriptions. Keep the change in the Claude Code provider.
2825.caveats: The repository behavior was reproduced with a synthetic authoritative probe payload. The installed Claude Code version was older, so the release-specific probe output was not observed directly.
